# CLI UX Design

Experience model: interactive_prompts — gh-style noun-verb subcommands with
on-demand Bubble Tea prompts when required input is missing.

## Libraries

- tui_framework: bubbletea (Elm-style interactive prompts)
- styling: lipgloss (declarative terminal styling)
- forms: huh (composable form & menu builder)
- progress: mpb (concurrent progress bars for long-running operations)

See ADR-0002 (Bubble Tea choice) and ADR-0003 (subcommand structure).
